sections.scene: Late afternoon on a vast salt desert. <Subject 1>, a mechanic in a faded red scarf, stands beside a stalled solar rover while a distant dust column approaches.
sections.shot_list: 0.00-1.20s: wide stillness around the rover. 1.20-3.40s: <Subject 1> notices the dust and closes the engine panel. 3.40s-end: the rover powers on as the approaching convoy resolves in the heat haze.
sections.acting: A small glance triggers a practical sequence: close the panel, secure the latch, rise and shield the eyes. Keep weight and hand contacts physically grounded.
sections.light_and_image: Hard amber side light, pale salt reflections, fine airborne dust, sun-worn fabric and realistic metallic heat shimmer.
sections.camera: Begin low beside the rover wheel and perform one measured crane rise into a wider reveal; no cut.
sections.production_sound: Dry wind, cooling metal ticks, latch contact, electric motor startup and a distant layered engine rumble.
sections.non_diegetic_music: One restrained analog bass note appears with the convoy silhouette, then holds.
sections.negatives: No extra vehicles appearing suddenly, no rover deformation, no floating dust indoors, no face drift, no speed ramp, no text or logo.
